d: Iran has warned that any fresh attack could trigger retaliation with 'no geographical limits', raising fears of a wider conflict in West Asia. Tehran has placed its military forces on high alert, while Iran's leadership has ordered an unrestricted response to any potential attack. The warning comes as US President Donald Trump signals the possibility of fresh strikes, claiming that remaining Iranian nuclear sites could be hit within minutes.
